title: Pale Vault Glacier - Snow-Hushed Town
_note: Option B mood sibling. gbc 4-voice band, 80 BPM (gbc floor, OK). The ice-TOWN: people and lanterns here. A small warm hummable melody framed by cold. Gentle A minor warming toward C major. Vesper motif TENDER MINOR reading, sung softly and nearly complete (E4->A4->B4 leap, C5->B4->A4 settle), the minor colouring the hope as fragile. Quiet heartbeat bass; one distant aurora swell (ohat) per phrase. 18-bar loop; last bar lands on E (the v) leaning back into the bar-1 A-minor lift.
key: A minor warming to C major
